summary: SL Science Holding Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Taipei-based Nasdaq-listed bioproducts foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing its election under Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5615(a)(3)(A) to follow Cayman Islands home-country governance practice in lieu of eight Nasdaq 5600 Series requirements: majority-independent board, independent-director sessions, annual meeting deadline, proxy solicitation, and the four shareholder-approval rules covering acquisitions, change of control, equity compensation, and 20%-plus discounted issuances. Cayman counsel Ogier supplied the required certification letter as Exhibit 99.1. Signature: CEO William Wang. This is a routine foreign-issuer governance exemption notice, not a special-situation transaction.
